title: Glowing hole in bedroom wall and electrical failure

tellings.quote: there's about a 4 and 1 half or 5T hole diameter in a north wall of my bedroom

plain: In 2017, at his home in Georgia, a former nuclear security guard named Mario Woods says a glowing hole "about a 4 and 1 half or 5T" across appeared in the north wall of his bedroom, and his electricity failed. Woods tells Michels this as something he lived through, in an episode about his account of being abducted, and he mentions someone named Jake in the story.
